instruction: Install the Immersive Reader extension in Chrome.
gt_steps: Open the Chrome Web Store listing `Immersive Reader` with extension ID `cccnhdbjafjobcppogeaaabofifbpdho`.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$id='cccnhdbjafjobcppogeaaabofifbpdho'; $root=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Google\Chrome\User Data'; $found=Get-ChildItem $root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName ('Extensions\' + $id) } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($found) { Write-Output 'IMMERSIVE_READER_EXTENSION_FOUND'; exit 0 }; Write-Output 'IMMERSIVE_READER_EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND'; exit 1"
